subject: Request: PLG amnesty — one-time POC credit for StratEdge
messages:
From: Luis Ramos <luis@stratedge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extra runway + POC credits

Hi Hannah,

Quick note — the team hit an internal delay (legal + infra) and we’re behind schedule on the evaluation. We’re at the point where the models are useful, but we need another 30–45 days and roughly 200k tokens of test traffic to finish a final integration test.

We had hoped to stay within the PLG sandbox limits but the delay eats the runway. Is there any way RedWood can provide a one-time POC credit top-up (tokens/credits) and a 30–45 day extension so we can complete the integration?

If needed I can get our procurement contact on a call this week. Appreciate any help — we like the perf so far and want to convert, but we need a little runway.

—Luis
Luis Ramos
CTO, StratEdge
Luis.R@stratedge.com

Attachment: StratEdge_POC_SOW.pdf (pdf)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:02:15 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: extra runway + POC credits

Team — forwarding StratEdge ask. Summary: external CTO requests a one-time top-up of ~200k tokens and a 30–45 day extension due to customer-side delays. StratEdge is a mid-market prospect, strong fit for Dedicated if we convert. Current PLG allotment exhausted; this is outside standard automatic top-ups.

My recommendation: approve a one-time token credit (I propose 150k tokens / ~$1,800 equivalent) and a 30-day extension. Ask: decision needed from Deal Desk / CRO for exception. Will require a procurement signature on a short addendum and a one-time credit approval form (attached).

Why smaller than they asked: preserves precedent, keeps conversion economics reasonable, and gives them enough runway to finish integration. If CRO wants to be aggressive we can bump to 200k, but I want clear acceptance terms (no price changes, standard T&Cs).

Att: StratEdge_POC_SOW.pdf, CreditApprovalForm.xlsx

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:34:40 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: extra runway + POC credits

+1 to Hannah’s suggested approach. Capture: 1) one-time credit only (no change to pricing), 2) 30-day extension, 3) procurement signature on addendum, 4) success criteria: API throughput test + perf verification within extension. If they meet success criteria, prioritize them for an intro to Solutions Eng for Dedicated sizing.

Operational note: put a hard cap at 150k tokens; we set an internal flag so we don’t create a precedent for “unlimited” top-ups. If CRO wants to stretch to 200k, we need to add an exec note and legal signoff.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, North America Sales

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 11:46:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: extra runway + POC credits

Hannah / Jonas — approved with conditions. One-time authorization: 150,000 token credit and a 30-day extension. Conditions: 1) Procurement must sign the attached addendum within 5 business days; 2) Customer agrees to defined success criteria in the SOW (itemized in the attached SOW); 3) No changes to list pricing or discounting for this exception; 4) If customer requests additional credit after the extension, we escalate to Deal Desk with renewal economics.

Marissa, please add a line to the addendum clarifying audit/logging retention and that this credit is a non-recurring concession. I’m logging this as one-off exception under DEAL-7839. Finance: chargeback will be recorded to promo budget.

Aditya
Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: CreditApprovalForm.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Luis Ramos <luis@stratedge.com>, procurement@stratedge.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: extra runway + POC credits

Luis — good news. We can approve a one-time 150,000 token credit and a 30-day extension under a short addendum. Next steps:

• I’ve attached the addendum and the approval form; please have your procurement rep sign the addendum within 5 business days.
• Success criteria (from SOW): complete end-to-end API integration test, validate latency under 200ms p95 on a 500-concurrent request profile, and pass export/import checks for prefix KV caching.
• Once we have the signed addendum, I’ll apply the credit and extend the sandbox. If you hit the success criteria early, we’ll prioritize a Solutions Eng call to discuss Dedicated sizing and an intro to our implementation playbook.

DocuSign link: https://docu.sign/abcd-POC-addendum
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/DEAL-7839

Thanks — we want this to be simple and help you get to a production decision.

Best,
